parameters.query: =WITH output_update AS (UPDATE content_outputs SET qa_status='{{$json.qa_status}}',updated_at=now() WHERE job_id=NULLIF('{{$json.job_id}}','')::uuid AND qa_status='pending' RETURNING id), report_insert AS (INSERT INTO content_outputs (job_id,output_type,title,structured_data,qa_status) VALUES (NULLIF('{{$json.job_id}}','')::uuid,'qa_report','QA Report','{{$json.qa_sql}}'::jsonb,'passed') RETURNING id), job_update AS (UPDATE content_jobs SET status='waiting_for_human_review',updated_at=now() WHERE id=NULLIF('{{$json.job_id}}','')::uuid RETURNING id), event_insert AS (INSERT INTO content_events (job_id,event_type,message,metadata) SELECT NULLIF('{{$json.job_id}}','')::uuid,'qa_completed','QA completed',jsonb_build_object('updated_outputs',(SELECT count(*) FROM output_update),'qa_report_id',(SELECT id FROM report_insert)))) SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM output_update) AS updated_outputs, (SELECT id::text FROM report_insert) AS qa_report_id;
